content.text: The text combines several unrelated narratives. In the Andes, Sam rescues Jimmie and Carl from jaguars in a ruined temple, escapes with them through secret underground passages to the forest and the _Ann_, and later joins Havens in capturing Redfern at a mountain fortress. The boys uncover that the “Mystery of the Andes” is merely an electrically lit hideout. A Cornish travel memoir follows visitors from the Lizard, Kynance Cove, and Land’s End to Marazion, St. Michael’s Mount, St. Ives, and Tintagel. Other selections describe a tame white mouse, advice on professions and goose-rearing, and a naval surgeon’s hardships aboard a gunboat and patrols along Africa’s coast.
